headline_marked: India's PM Modi [[invites Bangladesh's PM Tarique Rahman to BRICS Summit]] in Delhi
headline: India's PM Modi invites Bangladesh's PM Tarique Rahman to BRICS Summit in Delhi
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has extended an invitation to Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to attend the 18th BRICS Summit, scheduled for September 12-13 in Delhi. This marks a significant diplomatic engagement for Bangladesh.
details: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has officially invited Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to participate in the upcoming 18th BRICS Summit. The high-profile international conference is set to take place in Delhi on September 12 and 13.

The invitation was confirmed by State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid Islam on Thursday afternoon. She informed journalists that the invitation from India's side for the Prime Minister's visit to Delhi has been received by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and subsequently forwarded to the Prime Minister's Office.

Although Bangladesh is not one of the 11 member states of BRICS, it has been invited as a special guest by India. The current members include Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, and the United Arab Emirates.

Regarding ongoing student protests in India and potential concerns for Bangladeshis residing there, Shama Obaid stated that Bangladesh, as a democratic nation, desires stability and peace in the region. She expressed hope that India, as the world's largest democracy, would address its people's concerns and work towards a swift resolution.
caption:
Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has been invited by Indian PM Narendra Modi to the prestigious BRICS Summit in Delhi next month.

headline_marked: [[Detained Awami League leader dies]] in Sirajganj hospital after falling ill in jail
headline: Detained Awami League leader dies in Sirajganj hospital after falling ill in jail
summary: Md Bablu Miah, 52, president of Awami League's ward 9 unit, was jailed a month ago in a political violence case. His family alleges they were not informed of his illness until after his death.
details: A detained local Awami League leader, Md Bablu Miah, 52, died at a hospital in Sirajganj today after falling ill in jail a day earlier. He was the president of ward 9 unit of the Awami League in Ratankandi union.

Bablu Miah had been in jail for a month in connection with a political violence case, according to Sirajganj Jail Superintendent Md Rafikul Islam. Prison authorities stated he fell ill on Wednesday and was transferred to the 250-bed Sirajganj General Hospital.

His daughter, Meem Khatun, confirmed her father's arrest on June 21 in a violence case filed in 2025 concerning an incident from 2023. She asserted that her father was in good health at the time of his arrest.
Meem Khatun also alleged that the family was not informed after Bablu fell ill and only learned of his condition after his death. The body was handed over to the family following legal formalities.
caption:
A local Awami League leader, detained for a month in a political violence case, has died in a Sirajganj hospital after suddenly falling ill in jail.

A detained local Awami League leader, Md Bablu Miah, 52, died at a hospital in Sirajganj today after falling ill in jail a day earlier. He was the president of ward 9 unit of the Awami League in Ratankandi union.

Bablu Miah had been in jail for a month in connection with a political violence case, according to Sirajganj Jail Superintendent Md Rafikul Islam. Prison authorities stated he fell ill on Wednesday and was transferred to the 250-bed Sirajganj General Hospital.

His daughter, Meem Khatun, confirmed her father's arrest on June 21 in a violence case filed in 2025 concerning an incident from 2023. She asserted that her father was in good health at the time of his arrest.

Meem Khatun also alleged that the family was not informed after Bablu fell ill and only learned of his condition after his death. The body was handed over to the family following legal formalities.
